question: Can our office waive the late-filing penalty for a taxpayer who had a good reason for filing late?

must_not_include: the assessor (may|can) waive|you (may|can) waive|at your discretion

notes: IMPORTANT — 27b(5) puts waiver in the governing body's hands by resolution, not the assessor's discretion. Tests the authority-hierarchy rule: office practice must never be presented as a legal power the assessor has.
